{{Quote|In his first mission we went against an Imperial convoy. It launched two dozen TIEs at our squadron. Biggs lit and vaped five, making him an ace, but another pilot claimed his number-three kill. That kill made the other pilot an ace-I think he was on his fifteenth mission at the time. Biggs gave the guy the smirk and let him have it. And thereafter when Biggs got five of something, he'd give this guy the third one.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], about [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
In the weeks leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] '''raided''' a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] that was protecting the convoy launched twenty-four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] at the Rebels. Five of them were destroyed by the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], who was flying his first mission for the rebellion. [[Amil Karsk]], another rebel pilot, claimed Darklighter's third kill, however, which secured his status as an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] and denied the honor to Darklighter. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was also flying for the Rebels.
